key_catalyst: Apple wipes out $475 billion in value on earnings disappointment, effectively offset by massive surges in Amazon and Microsoft.
reasoning: The intraday session featured a massive divergence in mega-cap earnings, with Apple wiping out $475 billion in value while Amazon and Microsoft surged on strong cloud results and lowered capex forecasts. Despite the historic Apple drag, QQQ stabilized near flat (-0.31%), indicating the market is rationally offsetting hardware weakness with resolving AI capex fears rather than exhibiting complacency. Overnight gap-down risk is muted as the discrete earnings shocks are fully priced in and the structural bid for AI and cloud infrastructure remains intact.
